===Specifications=== :;Banana Pi RPI M6 board *CPU: [[Synaptics]] VS680/[[SenaryTech]] SN3680 (ARMv8-A 64-bit) :SoC: Quad-Core ARM (Cortex-A73) @2.1GHz :+ 1x (Cortex-M3) @ 250MHz *GPU: ''PowerVR GE9920''; NPU Support 6.75T; :VPU (with 4Kp60 H265, H264, VP9, ​​VP8, AV1, MPEG-2 :video decoding, Dual 1080p60 H.264/VP8 video encoding) *Storage: 16GB (eMMC 5.1) Flash, 16MB (SPI NOR) Flash, :TF Card (max.256GB)/MMC Card slot *Memory: 4GB (LPDDR4x) RAM *USB: 4x USB 3.0 ports *mPCIe: 1x M.2 2230 (Key E) (PCIe + MIPI CSI) *Network: 1x GbE port (supports :PoE with add-on PoE HAT) *GPIO: 1x 40-pin connector *Power Source: USB (Type-C) 5V/3A or :via PoE expansion
